impl.summary: Video tools → Remove dialogue (/video-tools/remove-dialogue) is built on the open engine, with three outcomes: No dialogue (the default), Dialogue only, and Lower the music (−30 to 0 dB, default −12). It runs as two steps in one createPipeline batch. First, graph A (separate-soundtrack-dbs on oss-dbs-separate) reads the video's soundtrack with LoadAudio. Then the stream-copy mux on oss-mux runs: the background or voice stem goes through video-mux-audio-replace, and Lower the music runs video-mux-audio with audio = voice, audio2 = background and backgroundVolumeDb. No new ComfyUI graph was needed. owner-decisions.json has samAudioCloud: false, so there is no cloud route: the cloud engine says the tool runs on your GPU (open source), Engine mode 'Paid APIs only' refuses it with that reason, and the cloud dub is untouched. Commits f9f3261c and cadabebb are signed (SSH).

findings.detail: POST /api/audio-tools (not ?preview=1) answers 403 own-gpu-tool to every account at the proxy. The branch's own test asserts this (tests/public-signup-tools.test.ts, 'Remove dialogue (DBS D2)'), and docs/public-signup.md L193-195 says so for this route. The page still treats a visitor like the owner. An account with its own GPU can upload a video (useAskBeforeUpload lets it through). The price check (priceAs, demo:false, costUsd 0) then shows 'Free · runs on your ComfyUI · about N s on your GPU', the hero says 'Runs on your ComfyUI … free', and the Remove dialogue button only fails after the click, with a 403. The base fixed exactly this for the other tools that never run on an account's GPU, in commits 25eac1ff ('visitors learn up front that self-hosted-only tools don't run here') and 0b2c24bc ('visitors read "Self-hosted only", not "Free · your GPU"'). Remove object follows that pattern at remove-object-tool.tsx L77/217/242/248: useLikelyVisitor, a SelfHostNote, a blocker, no upload or run, and ToolShell selfHostedOnly. This new page follows none of it. (D1's Split soundtrack page has the same gap; it was already on the base.)
findings.verified: Traced it: the proxy's account() falls through to ownGpuTool() for POST /api/audio-tools, and the branch's test expects 403 own-gpu-tool. The account preview test expects {costUsd:0, demo:false}, so money() prints 'Free · runs on your ComfyUI'. grep finds no useLikelyVisitor, SelfHostNote or selfHostedOnly in remove-dialogue-tool.tsx.
findings.fix: Follow remove-object-tool.tsx: const visitor = useLikelyVisitor(). Show <SelfHostNote>Remove dialogue runs on a self-hosted Fuobe for now.</SelfHostNote>, make the blocker say the same, turn off upload, 'From library' and the run, show 'Self-hosted only' in place of 'Free · runs on your ComfyUI', drop 'on your ComfyUI … free' from the hero for visitors, and pass ToolShell selfHostedOnly. The other way is to let accounts run it on their own ComfyUI: it is two plain open-engine steps with no AI helper, so the rule doesn't require own-gpu-tool. That needs accountRun plus the account-inputs checks and a tests/account-*.test.ts, so it is a bigger change.

findings.title: Compare on an earlier run doesn't bring back its outcome or level in the controls
findings.detail: onOpen sets source and ran.outcome = outcomeOf(r), but never calls setOutcome or setMusicDb. When you reopen a 'Lower the music (−20 dB)' run while the controls say 'No dialogue', the Before/After panel shows the Lower run while the 'What to keep' control, the summary and the run button still say No dialogue. Pressing the button then runs the outcome on screen, not the one that was reopened.
findings.verified: Read the code: onOpen calls setSource and setRan only.
findings.fix: In onOpen, call setOutcome(outcomeOf(r)) and, for lower-music, setMusicDb(r.request.params?.extra?.backgroundVolumeDb ?? LOWER_DEFAULT_DB).

fix.finalSummary: Open engine (ComfyUI + ComfyUI-DBS, CPU or GPU): Video tools → Remove dialogue offers No dialogue, Dialogue only and Lower the music (−30…0 dB). It runs as two steps in one batch, graph A then the stream-copy mux, and keeps the removed stem as a download. The implementer and reviewer verified it on the CPU ComfyUI: picture packets are byte-identical for MP4, MOV and WebM, the stems add back exactly, and the mix level is right. Compare now restores the outcome and level. Cloud engine: no route, because samAudioCloud is false and DBS isn't hosted. The page says it runs on your GPU (open source), and 'Paid APIs only' refuses it. The cloud dub is unchanged. Needs a GPU: only for speed (it runs on CPU). No keys are needed. Public sign-up: guests and accounts can open /video-tools/remove-dialogue and /audio/split. Both pages now say up front that the tool runs on a self-hosted Fuobe for now, show 'Self-hosted only', and turn off upload, library pick and run. The price check (?preview=1) still works and is priced for the visitor's own GPU, on its own files only. A POST run is refused at the proxy with own-gpu-tool. The owner's pages are unchanged. Next-step chips keep Upscale and add Remove dialogue only for clips likely to have speech.
left: There is no cloud route while samAudioCloud is false. If the owner turns it on, the SAM Audio routes (extract-soundtrack → sam-audio-separate 'speech' → merge-audio-video, and loudnorm + compose for Lower) and the sam-audio-separate catalog entry are still to build.
Accounts can't run Remove dialogue or Split soundtrack on their own ComfyUI. Opening that (accountRun + account-inputs checks + a tests/account-*.test.ts) is an owner/plan decision.
Not verifiable here: GPU timing, separation quality on real dialogue, and paid calls.

Speech-likely clips now show Extend, Upscale, Remove dialogue as their three chips, so Split soundtrack moves to the menu for them. The owner may want a different order.
